presentation.label: Three-grain USB candidate
presentation.summary: Three overlapping grains with centered SIZE, wrapping POS and native FLEX pitch.
presentation.overview: Three-grain track machine. USB release candidate; publication and exact-package hardware qualification pending.
highlights: Three grains; SIZE expands around POS and wraps sample edges.
Native pitch at MAIN F, neutral 64.
One owner on T1–T4; no active SPACE or FX2 effect.
usage: On a compatible private paired build, choose FRACT in SRC SETUP on T1 and load a FLEX sample.
Open MAIN, keep PTCH at 64, move POS, then increase SIZE to expand the span around the center.
Play the track, try SPRD and REVS, then stop playback and select a stock machine to leave FRACT.

access.location: SRC SETUP > FRACT on a compatible private paired build

controls.name: POS
controls.doc: Grain center from left to right across the source.

controls.name: SIZE
controls.doc: Grain duration and centered span; wraps source edges.

controls.name: REVS
controls.doc: Forward probability: 127 forward, 0 reverse; intermediate values mix at grain births.

controls.name: SPRD
controls.doc: Random displacement of grain centers around POS.

controls.name: SHPE
controls.doc: Grain window shape, constrained by short sizes.

controls.name: PTCH
controls.doc: Native FLEX pitch; saved 64 is neutral, with native bounded editor and formatter.

controls.name: PAN
controls.doc: Random grain stereo width; zero is balanced.

controls.name: SRNG
controls.doc: FULL uses the source span; LOCAL caps spread extent at 88,200 source frames.

limitations: Unlisted source draft; not offered by the public configurator.
Eight registry slots exist; FRACT admits only one owner on T1–T4.
Private build requires an exact compatible paired base with FR:1 boot preservation.
Candidate functional lifecycle recorded; full resource, stress and companion qualification pending.

processing.label: Worst-case ColdFire work
processing.conditions: Worst render timing and matched FLEX comparison not measured; functional hardware checks do not measure cycles.

impact.conditions: One FRACT owner on T1–T4, three grain heads, moving controls and native-pitch packet splits. Stock sample pages are reused. Replacement temporarily retains two module extents.

cpu.rationale: Audio-rate ColdFire work for three interpolated/windowed stereo readers, unlike a key-only feature; native pitch and split packets affect work. No measured processor percentage or headroom claim.

dsp.rationale: No added DSP engine code or DSP state; native FLEX/DSP processing remains instrument-owned.

memory.rationale: 31,792 resident pool bytes for code/tables/state/header, up to 712 own stack bytes per callback, no independent sample buffer; replacement retains two extents.
